purpose: Teach: 島田/町田/森山/前原/足立/平山/椎名/村田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の島田先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — take over Professor Shimada's research from your advisor.
lines.style: Steady directive. Clear-eyed assignment of responsibility. No question in it. The weight lands soft but lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。町田教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Machida's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Immediate acceptance. Quiet note-taking energy. Ready, already thinking ahead to the work. No ceremony.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の森山先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to Professor Moriyama about the collaborative research.
lines.style: Another task in a series. Clipped, purposeful. Building a map for him, not explaining why.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で前原助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend Assistant Professor Maehara's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Absorbing instruction into action. Practical, already mentally scheduling. A beat of resolve underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の足立先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — look at Professor Adachi's literature as well for reference.
lines.style: Adding to the foundation. Still steady, still without urgency. He's building Ren a scaffold, one piece at a time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の平山先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask Senior Hirayama in the lab for guidance.
lines.style: Accepting again. Polite acknowledgment of hierarchy. A softening here — he's naming a real person, a senpai, not just a task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の椎名教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with Professor Shiina on the international partnership.
lines.style: The final thread. Same measured tone, but this one reaches outward. Still directive, still composed. A glance at global scope.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、村田事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application to Murata in the administrative office for research funding.
lines.style: Last response. A close — practical, completing the circuit. The exhale of someone who's taken it all in. Ready to begin.
